text:
sre-bot: :warning: ALERT: apac1 control-plane KV store reports checksum errors, multiple leader elections in 30s window (alert-id=apac1-kv-CHK-421)

maria (oncall): seeing widespread 401s from hosted API in apac1, consoles 502 when hitting /console/ui

arun (infra): confirmed KV instability. etcd peers flapping, disk IOPS bursts on node apac1-db-3. Not clear if corruption or metadata replay issue.

katy (platform): are auth tokens failing to validate or is config fetch timing out? need scope before shifting traffic.

maria (oncall): auth failures look upstream — token introspect endpoint returns 500s. sample: `curl -sS https://apac1-controlplane/auth/introspect -d 'token=...'` returns `{"error":"kv-err","code":500}`

jamal (prod-eng): customers calling in, a few reported model-serving fallbacks to smaller quantized variants. Latency for generation + tailing 200-500ms higher in APAC.

lucas (deploy): deploy-bot shows a config rollout paused 3min ago for apac1 due to control-plane healthcheck failure.

maria (oncall): runbook step 1: mark control-plane as degraded and start traffic shift to na-central1. Doing weighted route change to 0.2->0.8 now.

arun (infra): initiating partial evacuation of schedulers from apac1. Will cordon nodes labeled controlplane=true, drain non-critical pods. ETA 8m.

katy (platform): console sessions will be lost during route shift. Post message to #status with current impact. I'll prepare a rollback plan if auth fixes quickly.

maria (oncall): traffic shift applied: routing weight apac1=20% -> na-central1=80%. Monitoring errors and token failures.

sre-bot: routing change completed by router-bot at 1968888952. Observability: 401 rate back to baseline in na-central1, apac1 still 60% of previous 401 spike.

arun (infra): discovered corrupted raft log file on apac1-db-3. Copying healthy snapshot from apac1-db-1 and will attempt repair. This may force a full rejoin and short quorum loss.

jamal (prod-eng): we need immediate mitigation for Dedicated customers in APAC — can we spin extra dedicated capacity in apac-edge pool? cost might be higher (on-demand).

katy (platform): quick cost call: spinning on-demand GPUs in apac-edge will add ~30% hourly over reserved. Approve if SRE needs warm capacity.

maria (oncall): approved for emergency on-demand bursts up to 10 nodes. arun, please provision. Tag resources with incident=apac1-kv so finance can track.

arun (infra): provisioning on-demand instances apac-edge-gpu-1..5. CLI: `infra create node --region apac-edge --type p8 --count 5 --tags incident=apac1-kv`

lucas (deploy): deploy-bot attempted a control-plane config push at 1968889100, aborted due to handshake timeout with apac1-control. Logs: ```2026-03-18T09:31:40Z ERROR push: handshake failed: rpc: timeout```

maria (oncall): console access still flaky for apac1 tenants. Using support proxy to retrieve logs for customers impacted. Please avoid mass retries; that exacerbates KV load.

arun (infra): repair running. If rebuild succeeds we'll rejoin nodes and start healing. If not, plan is promote apac1-db-1 snapshot and rebuild apac1-db-3 from snapshot; expect 15-25m.

katy (platform): rolling failover notice drafted for status page. Will include guidance: temporary auth errors, console intermittent, model-serving fallbacks active; recommend customers route to na-central1 region for latency-sensitive workloads.

jamal (prod-eng): edge-case: evals relying on pinned model-version in apac1 will see mismatches if we shift routing. We're flagging those teams.

maria (oncall): SLO impact: auth 99.9 for apac1 breached. Escalating to SEV2. tagging leadership.

sre-bot: incident timeline event: traffic shift at 1968888952, repair start at 1968889030, on-demand nodes requested at 1968889075.

arun (infra): repair finished on apac1-db-3 at 1968889180. Raft logs trimmed, peers stable. Reconciliation of control-plane started (healthchecks greening).

maria (oncall): bringing routing weight back gradually: na-central1->60%, apac1->40%. Monitoring token introspect errors.

sre-bot: observations: token-introspect 500s down from 60%->15% after repair and traffic adjustment. Console 502s reduced but sessions require re-auth.

katy (platform): rolling paused config rollout will be retried once control-plane fully stable. deploy-bot will requeue push at 1968889250.

lucas (deploy): requeue scheduled. Note: we saw a few bad config diffs in the paused push; will hold until signoff from katy.

maria (oncall): incident summary for now: KV corruption in apac1 caused auth/token introspect failures and paused config rollouts; traffic was shifted to na-central1, emergency on-demand GPU burst provisioned for Dedicated customers; repair completed and routing partially restored. Follow-ups: RCA, disk IOPS baseline, stricter snapshot cadence, and emergency cost tracker.

jamal (prod-eng): thumbs up. I'll coordinate with teams impacted by rollout pause and pinned-model workarounds.

katy (platform): will publish post-incident note after RCA draft.

maria (oncall): closing SEV2 to monitoring state at 1968889210. If regressions appear reopen thread. :white_check_mark:
